Game Overview

At its heart, Jumper Rabbit is a hyper-casual game about leap into adventure with Jumper Rabbit, where precision hopping and timing are key. Help a spirited rabbit navigate tricky platforms, dodge perilous obstacles, and collect as many carrots as possible. With charming visuals and addictive gameplay, it's a delightful challenge that keeps all players coming back for more.
